BrowserActor.description: Verified human session lookup and HTTP context; never a public body.
BrowserActor.title: BrowserActor

BrowserContext.description: Trusted HTTP adapter projection; CSRF comparisons must be constant-time.
BrowserContext.title: BrowserContext

GrantAuthority.description: Incarnation advances on remove/regrant; membership revision is ordinary CAS.
GrantAuthority.title: GrantAuthority

Membership.description: Current application grant, loaded independently of credential claims.
Membership.title: Membership

ProductAuthorityEnvelope.description: Schema carrier for the mandatory internal union, never a public HTTP envelope.
ProductAuthorityEnvelope.title: ProductAuthorityEnvelope

RunAuthorityState.description: Current owner, run, lease and complete credentials; currency is a producer obligation.
RunAuthorityState.title: RunAuthorityState

RunCoordinatorAuthority.description: Current independently verified internal coordinator authorization, never a client body.
RunCoordinatorAuthority.title: RunCoordinatorAuthority

RunCredentialPlan.description:
Atomic proposal; issue_claims is an original-handler directive, never a bearer.

Only a real producer that confirms the commit and rechecks current authority may
deliver once. A metadata-only retry returns RunCredentialResponse, never this plan.
RunCredentialPlan.title: RunCredentialPlan

RunCredentialPolicy.description: Explicit immutable issuer settings; no approved production defaults.
RunCredentialPolicy.title: RunCredentialPolicy

RunCredentialRecord.description: Retained authoritative state; no serialized bearer or signing material.
RunCredentialRecord.title: RunCredentialRecord

RunCredentialSet.description: Complete retained run state, under one shared run/credential serialization domain.
RunCredentialSet.title: RunCredentialSet

RunOwnership.description: Immutable admission record; creator leaf credentials are audit metadata only.
RunOwnership.title: RunOwnership

RunTokenClaims.description: Mint proposal or actual verified claims, distinguished by their producer.
RunTokenClaims.title: RunTokenClaims

ServiceKeyRecord.description: Private verifier digest; never expose this record through a public route.
ServiceKeyRecord.title: ServiceKeyRecord

ServiceKeySet.description: Complete retained key records under the shared principal lock, never one page.
ServiceKeySet.title: ServiceKeySet

ServiceKeyState.description: Secret-free durable key state; current validity still needs current ancestry.
ServiceKeyState.title: ServiceKeyState

SessionCredential.description: Trusted hash lookup result, including narrowly retained logout-only history.
SessionCredential.title: SessionCredential

SessionRecord.description: Current server session family; no opaque cookie secret is stored here.
SessionRecord.title: SessionRecord

description: C2 private producer messages, not public mint routes or evidence of token verification, current database state, signing, delivery or commit.
